name: The Storm Herald
notes: DRAFT for C13-6 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Brown-Black Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases (66% and 33%, Manager's call). Stats are TODO for the Researcher. Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: thunder clap
attacks.note: Claps once; a big red circle, then a short calm.

phases.tell: Its cloak puffs out; red circle.
Its hands rise high; big red circle.
phases.counterplay: Step out, then wait for the calm.
phases.senseiLine: After the thunder comes a quiet beat.

phases.tell: A striped zigzag, then a lane, each with double marks.
phases.senseiLine: Loud is not the same as strong. DASH.

lines.intro: The storm is so loud. Can you hear the calm?
lines.freed: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.
lines.senseiAfter: You stayed steady inside the storm.

description: The Storm Herald pushes with wind, claps thunder, then zigzags striped lightning followed by one lane.

bestiary.tip: Wait for the quiet beat between the storms.

lore.brown-black: A tall figure of wind and lightning. It shouts the storm louder so no one hears the calm. Free it, and its light comes home.
